position: A listed-equity position disclosed within statutory 3-day notification for a 6% voting holding.
A derivatives position on an index future held without the required margin posted at the clearinghouse.
An index-options book with the position limits for the relevant reportable contract respected.
A basket trade marked at a stale close rather than an executable mid, breaching the valuation policy.
A position in a retail-accessible ETF with a UTI (unique trade identifier) attached and reported.
A short position on an index constituent not flag-marked as a short, breaching disclosure.
A cleared OTC equity swap with both legs reported to the trade repository.
A derivative position sized so the entity exceeds the default capital threshold without a capital add-on.
An index future hedging a physical portfolio with the exposures mapped and the hedge ratio within tolerance.
A market-making position on a small-cap index member that breaches the position transparently, undisclosed.
